_why: Round 34 站0/站1. The H1 anchor rule is implemented twice: scripts/file_loader.py
checks the file on disk, and the workflow JS checks the text the shell-wrapper
agent handed back. Those are different inputs on purpose — the JS layer exists to
catch an agent that did not faithfully `cat` the file (file_loader.py's own
docstring: Bug v5 'Acknowledged' preamble, Bug v8 fabricated content). They are
not allowed to be different RULES. Before this fixture existed the JS side used
/^#\s+[^\n]*<phrase>/m — 'any H1 line containing the phrase' — which passes the
preamble case it was built to reject.
`content` to a temp file and runs load_file(). Same verdict, every case, or one
